items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: Sinatra was awesome. I mean when I started I was kind of the young guy on the band... whether you’re playing a Billy May chart or a Nelson Riddle chart... I loved every minute of it.

ctx.x: Couldn’t play with anybody good, ey?

Yeah, I’m grateful for all the opportunities I’ve had. It’s been a terrific run. And if somebody would have told me 42 years ago when I got out of Eastman, “Here’s what you’re going to do would you take it right now?” I would take it in a heartbeat. And Sinatra was awesome. I mean when I started I was kind of the young guy on the band and the older guys who had been there for a long time, most of which are passed on now, they were really super great to me. They took me under their wing and the stories were…

— well the arrangements still exist — they’re just such absolute gems. And so it’s unlikely that there would be a big band that would have that many different arrangers with different styles but all be that great. So it was a very special book of music to get to play on a nightly basis.
